items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yes, yes. I forgot that Bill was on that.

ctx.x: Yeah. Dave Samuels, Formanek, Frisell – a very young Bill Frisell, probably.
Yes, yes. I forgot that Bill was on that. Jukkis – I didn’t know Jukkis. What’s that? Hell of a musician here. What the heck is this about? I had no idea what Finland was.
One of my – a great European drummer.
